The store was Pine Crossing. I've answered Pree in a thread under her message in #central-team.

It comes from Pree's own message in that channel on 9 June. She wrote that Pine Crossing's morning receiver saw only the afternoon shift on the appointment screen. A driver arrived at 7:10 and they wrote his trailer number on a sticky note.

Hollis replied that he'd check the shift template and ask support to reproduce the problem with the store login. Nobody has posted in the channel since saying it was fixed, so I suggested Pree check with Hollis before she updates the sheet.

I only used sources Pree can see herself: the #central-team channel (she's a member) and the public files. The share has no account files for Marrow Agrisupply.
